verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents both a Masked Email feature and alias setup. Several users confirm hands-on that masked emails work well for throwaway or sketchy sign-ups, that the feature needs only Fastmail via a settings option, and that subdomain addressing works where plus-addresses are rejected. Missing for 10: substantive first-party documentation content (only article titles are in the pack), and evidence about whether the real address stays hidden when replying or sending from a masked address.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address

citations.quote: Masked emails have been so nice for throwaway/sketchy sites.
you only need Fastmail; it's an option under settings
Subdomain addressing (foo@bar.mydomain.com) is a killer feature because sites reject plus-addresses.
